freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 通过邀请链接注册即可领取 30 天 Step Plan Plus 会员，会员额度内直接用 Claude Code 等编程工具调用 step-5-preview / step-3.7-flash / step-3.5-flash，不必再按 token 付费；Step Plan 不适用开放平台按累计充值金额划分的阶梯限速。活动期限与可用额度以控制台为准。
freeTierSummary.en: Sign up through the invitation link to claim a 30-day Step Plan Plus membership, then run step-5-preview / step-3.7-flash / step-3.5-flash inside Claude Code and other coding agents against the plan quota instead of per-token billing; Step Plan is not subject to the open platform's recharge-tiered rate limits. Check the console for current terms.
